reviews_1s:
This set of three funnels is great to have to -- for example -- put cologne and other liquids into smaller containers if you buy a large size. I have not yet been able to use them, however, because there is a little white plastic tie that holds them together is impossible to remove without tearing off a finger nail or injuring yourself in some other way.

Should I use the tip of a steak knife, or a meat cleaver? Should I use my teeth. How do you separate these three funnels?While these are inexpensive funnels, I expected a little more than this.

I purchased these to use with food items. The product looks used.
As the photos show, the funnels are stained & discolored. There is some rust as well.
Also in the photos, you can see that only the largest size has the air relief groove. While the description doesn’t specifically say each funnel has the groove, it also doesn’t say or show, that the other two don’t, so the description is misleading.

I have not used these, but there is a small groove around the top of the “spout” in the bottom of the funnel that seems like it will trap small particles and make these less sanitary and would require special attention to cleaning as opposed to a one piece funnel.
The handles are not particularly well attached; though, since they aren’t likely to be holding a lot of weight, I do not know if this would become an issue or not. It may trap water and rust off eventually; or trap particles causing a sanitation issue down the road.There is an inner lip at the bottom of each funnel that makes use of powder a waste and I'll be looking for a different set. What a waste.I don’t even want to give this even one star. They came broken apart, but I dealt with it. Then, after only 2 uses, the bottom of one of the funnels completely broke off… horribly made productTerrible design. They're made from 2 pieces of metal - the handle & funnel part, and then the spigot part that extends into the container you're putting something into. Here's the problem...there's a lip on the inside of the funnel where the spigot part was put through the hole in the bottom and attached to the funnel. So if you're trying to pour any sort of powder through the funnel (and I assume liquids, too), it doesn't flow smoothly down into your container. A significant amount gets caught around the lip and either needs to be abandoned or somehow mechanically moved up over the lip and down into the spigot and container.Only biggest funnel was attached to the handle. Other two were brokenVery poorly made. The handles are just glued on. The mid size funnel handle was broken off which made it useless.One was broken upon receipt. I don’t feel like returning the set but still wish I had all three and worry another will break soon.Dry ingredients get caught on lip inside coneThese don't work because there is a ridge around the bottom where the funnel goes into the bottom tube. This prevents spices and liquids from going down. Very disappointed in these funnels.
